reuse.why: The change reuses findOrCreateBank and extracts shared linking, downloading, and link-clearing functions for existing providers and Fintegra.

duplication.why: Provider linking and transaction-download implementations are consolidated, while both unlinking paths share the same field-clearing definition.

placement.why: Database link rules remain in accounts/link.ts, request orchestration remains in accounts/app.ts, and provider downloads remain in accounts/sync.ts.

scope.why: The edits address the requested linking policies and Fintegra integration, with narrowly related refactoring and provider type integration.

maintainability.why: The shared functions make provider maintenance straightforward, although assertBankAccountNotLinked now also selects a replacement holder, making its assertion-oriented name misleading.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six registered linking handlers use guardBankAccountLink and linkBankSyncAccount, and both local unlink paths use clearAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The extracted linking and download functions replace existing copies rather than reshaping them into separate implementations.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a branch selecting rejection versus returning the holder; every linking handler still uses the shared guard.
